يحتجزن (form VIII)
# يَحْتَجِزْنَ (yaḥtajizna) /jaħ.ta.d͡ʒiz.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# يُحْتَجَزْنَ (yuḥtajazna) /juħ.ta.d͡ʒaz.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
